newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Head of African trade group suspended in money row.
newsitem.headline: Head of African trade group suspended in money row.

text.p: The Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa (Comesa) has suspended its secretary-general Bingu Wa Mutharika for alleged financial irregularities, a Comesa official said on Saturday.

Chaziya Thakakala, chairman of the Comesa council of ministers, told a news conference in Lusaka: "Mr Mutharika has been suspended for three months pending investigations into alleged financial abuses."
Thakakala, speaking at the end of a council of ministers meeting, gave no details of the allegations against Mutharika.
A final decision on Mutharika's status in the organisation is expected to be taken at a scheduled summit in March.
Comesa groups Angola, Burundi, Comores, Eritrea, Ethiopia, Kenya, Lesotho, Malawi, Madagascar, Mauritius, Mozambique, Namibia, Rwanda, Sudan, Swaziland, Tanzania, Uganda, Zaire, Zambia and Zimbabwe.
